name: Watermelon Burst - Infused Ice Packs (Rosin, Hash, and Diamonds) 5x 0.5g
description: Rove Ice Packs, the world’s first triple-infused preroll. Made with premium-grade flower fully-infused with THCA diamonds and solventless ice hash rosin then they're expertly rolled. Super smooth and ultra potent, Rove Ice Packs test up to 40% THC. Welcome to the next evolution of prerolls. Premium Organic Flower. With its unique flavor profile of sweet and earthy notes, this rare sativa marijuana strain is the perfect choice for cannabis connoisseurs looking for an energizing yet calming escape. Get ready for the perfect balance of relaxation and energy with our Watermelon Burst. Our strain offers a juicy mix of sweet melon, head-rushing euphoria and a unique smoking experience.
